questions.question: What is the principle of operation of a DC generator?
questions.tutor: DC generator converts mechanical energy to electrical by electromagnetic induction.

questions.question: What is the function of a commutator in a DC machine?
questions.tutor: Commutator rectifies AC armature voltage to DC output.

questions.question: What are the main parts of a DC machine?
questions.tutor: Field produces magnetic flux; armature carries current.

questions.question: What is back EMF in a DC motor?
questions.topic: Electrical Machines - DC Motor Back EMF
questions.tutor: Back EMF opposes armature current; Eb = Vt - IaRa.

questions.question: What is the speed equation of a DC shunt motor?
questions.tutor: Speed N ∝ Eb/φ where Eb = Vt - IaRa.

questions.question: What is the synchronous speed of an induction motor?
questions.tutor: Ns = 120 × frequency / number of poles (rpm).

questions.question: What is slip in an induction motor?
questions.tutor: Slip s = (Ns - Nr)/Ns, typically 2-5% at full load.

questions.question: Why does an induction motor draw high starting current?
questions.tutor: At start, rotor is stationary, slip=1, induced EMF is maximum, impedance is low.

questions.question: What is the function of a squirrel cage rotor?
questions.tutor: Squirrel cage rotor has aluminum or copper bars shorted at both ends.

questions.question: What is the difference between squirrel cage and wound rotor induction motor?
questions.tutor: Wound rotor has slip rings for external resistance; squirrel cage is simpler.

questions.question: What is a synchronous motor?
questions.tutor: Synchronous motor rotates at exactly Ns = 120f/P.

questions.question: What is the function of a damper winding in a synchronous motor?
questions.tutor: Damper winding provides starting torque and damps oscillations.

questions.question: What is the V-curve of a synchronous motor?
questions.tutor: V-curve shows armature current variation with field current at constant load.

questions.question: What is a transformer?
questions.tutor: Transformer transfers energy by electromagnetic induction without moving parts.

questions.question: What is the turns ratio of a transformer?
questions.tutor: Turns ratio a = Np/Ns = Vp/Vs = Is/Ip.

questions.question: What are the losses in a transformer?
questions.tutor: Core losses (hysteresis & eddy) and copper losses (I²R).

questions.question: What is the efficiency of a transformer at full load?
questions.tutor: Efficiency = output power / (output power + core loss + copper loss).

questions.question: What is voltage regulation of a transformer?
questions.tutor: Voltage regulation measures voltage drop from no-load to full-load.

questions.question: What is a generator?
questions.tutor: Generator converts mechanical energy (turbine, engine) to electrical energy.

questions.question: What is the power angle of a synchronous generator?
choices: Angle between rotor and stator fields
Phase angle between voltage and current
questions.tutor: Power angle δ is between rotor field and resultant stator field.

questions.question: What is an alternator?
questions.tutor: Alternator is a synchronous AC generator.

questions.question: What is the purpose of a brushless exciter?
questions.tutor: Brushless exciter eliminates slip rings and brushes for reliability.

questions.question: What is a universal motor?
choices: Runs on both AC and DC
questions.tutor: Universal motor is series-wound and operates on AC or DC (power tools).

questions.question: What is the starting torque of a series DC motor?
questions.tutor: Series motor has very high starting torque, used in cranes and trains.

questions.question: What happens if a series DC motor runs without load?
questions.tutor: No load causes dangerously high speed; never run series motor unloaded.
